demos.name: SPIFFE Issuer LAB
demos.description: Mints three test JWT-SVIDs (valid, mismatched, untrusted), publishes the JWKS and OIDC discovery a Privilege gateway can fetch, and presents each token to an MCP door: expect 200, 401, 401. A token minter, not SPIRE.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7829). Mock needs no tenant and no settings. Docker: docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Real needs a public https URL for /.well-known/ (PUBLIC_URL), the gateway origin and door names (SPIFFE_GW_URL, SPIFFE_GW_APPS) in the lab's own .env; the owner runs it.
